description.name: Entry
description.text:
Deadly Strikes +5% & 150 SB Points to party, Master Mode & Instant ATB 1 to user
Master Mode: Cap Break Level 2, Zero SB Cost 1 & Instant SB/LB Cast
Interval Chase: 10 single-target Prismatic/NE ranged hybrid attacks, Deadly Strikes +10/15/20/25/30% to party after 1/2/3/4/5 chases (max 5 chases)
Master Chase: Single-target Prismatic/NE piercing ranged hybrid attack at True Cap Break Level 1, Deadly Strikes +30% for 1 turn to party, removes Master Mode
